mainEntity.name: What is the process for selecting materials and finishes for a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The material selection process usually starts with design concepts, where we discuss your aesthetic preferences, functional needs, and budget. We can guide you through options for tiles, countertops, cabinetry, fixtures, and lighting, helping you understand durability and maintenance requirements. We also advise on lead times for specific materials, as this is a crucial preparation step that directly impacts the project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Material selection involves discussing design concepts, budget, and functional needs. We guide you through options for tiles, fixtures, and more, advising on material lead times to prepare for the project.
